scope: Warm module compile/link/evaluate microbenchmark; not a live Rome response, first-load or isolated JIT timing. No CPU instruction credit or whole-page speedup claimed.
change: Reuse an immutable VM-owned JSSourceCode/source provider after URL and full-source comparison, preserving the parser function-body cache across fresh realms. Thread-local per-VM LRU retains at most 128 entries and charges at most 16 MiB of source storage (additional JSC parser/code metadata is outside that accounting). Sources below 4096 UTF-16 units bypass retention. No page global, linked module namespace, author values or fetch results are cached; each realm must still fetch and rewrite the source through its own loader/security checks.
lifetime: A private context in the same group roots source cells without retaining retired page globals. Keep JSVirtualMachine wrapper alive because JSScript references it weakly. Eviction clears source roots even if temporary ObjC argument wrappers survive; VM replacement/thread destruction release remaining roots. Missing or incompatible jsSourceCode SPI signature bypasses the cache.

limitations: The change affects reuse within an already running agent VM. It does not precompile the first visit, persist native JIT code or reduce downloaded JS.
The previous warm ChatGPT reload bootstrap-gate failures remain unresolved; this result does not turn them into a successful warm-page measurement.
Private JSScript module integration remains OS dependent. Current native ARC/MRC/sanitizer and signed production checks pass on the pinned macOS/JSC.
Short native runs can finish between RSS samples. The sampled guard is not a peak-memory bound; source charge is not total JSC heap usage.
Microbenchmark controls/candidates share toolchain and native libraries. Production bundle is used only for functional checks; no timing comparison across unrelated C build modes.
No Brave speed ratio or instruction-counter claim is made. Native audit observation adds latency, and the single live response is functional evidence only.
